# RichPredict

> RichPredict is an AI-driven sports analytics and predictive intelligence platform providing high-probability forecasts for football, tennis, basketball, and global sports leagues.

RichPredict continuously processes historical head-to-head records, current team form, expected goals (xG), lineup dynamics, odds discrepancies, and algorithmic confidence metrics to deliver data-backed match predictions and statistical insights.

## Core Sports & Predictions

- [Football Predictions](https://richpredict.com/football): Comprehensive AI match previews, high-confidence 1X2 tips, over/under forecasts, and league analytics.
- [Tennis Predictions](https://richpredict.com/tennis): ATP, WTA, and Grand Slam tournament projections, player form indexes, and surface analysis.
- [Basketball Predictions](https://richpredict.com/basketball): NBA, EuroLeague, and international basketball game outcomes and point-spread insights.
- [All Sports Predictions](https://richpredict.com/predictions): Centralized directory of upcoming fixtures, expert analytics, and probability distributions.
- [Sports News & Previews](https://richpredict.com/news): Editorial match previews, breaking team news, injury updates, and tactical breakdowns.

## Machine-Readable Resources

- [Sitemap Index](https://richpredict.com/sitemap_index.xml): XML index of all sports fixtures, leagues, and dynamic content.
- [Static Sitemap](https://richpredict.com/sitemap-static.xml): XML list of all primary static routes and sport hubs.
- [News Sitemap](https://richpredict.com/sitemap-news.xml): Up-to-date XML feed of sports news and tactical previews.
- [Robots Configuration](https://richpredict.com/robots.txt): Crawler rules and directives for web search engines and AI agents.
